description: hexa harden runs the gate before attempting fixes and keeps gate output for reporting

specs.description: Gate runs once on the tree before any fixes are attempted
specs.given: A tree with a green gate
specs.then: The gate runs once before any fixes, records a green baseline, and proceeds to hunt

specs.description: The baseline is the full gate, not the fast one
specs.given: A project with a fast gate and a full gate, the tree green on both
specs.then: The baseline run is the full gate's command, labelled `baseline`, and the fast gate is not used for it

specs.description: A red gate stops the pass immediately
specs.given: A tree with a red gate
specs.then: The gate runs once, fails, and the pass stops without any fixes attempted

specs.description: A gate red twice spends no inference
specs.given: A tree whose gate fails both times it is run
specs.then: No lens is asked, nothing is verified and no fix is tried; the report says the gate is red before any fix, with its output, and `hexa harden` exits non-zero

specs.given: A tree with a red gate
specs.then: The baseline gate run is skipped, and the pass proceeds to hunt

specs.description: Without --no-baseline a red gate stops the pass
specs.given: A tree with a red gate
specs.then: The baseline runs, fails twice, and the pass stops before the hunt

specs.description: Gate output is kept for reporting
specs.then: The gate's output is kept and reported in the run record

specs.description: A failing gate prints its tail where it fails
specs.given: A fix whose gate run fails with 100 lines of output
specs.then: The last 12 lines are printed where it fails; the `GateRun` keeps the last 60 lines, labelled with the fix's title

specs.description: Gate output is bounded at 8 KiB
specs.given: A gate run with output larger than 8 KiB
specs.then: The kept output is bounded at 8 KiB

specs.description: Second failed fix checks the tree without fixes
specs.then: The gate runs on the reverted tree after the second failed fix

specs.description: A tree green without any fix lets the loop go on
specs.given: Two consecutive failed fixes on a tree that is green without fixes
specs.then: The gate runs on the reverted tree, passes, and the fix loop goes on to the next finding

specs.description: Gate result is recorded in the run record
specs.then: The gate result is recorded in ~/.hexa/runs/<id>.json

specs.description: A pass that fails says why without a rerun
specs.given: A pass whose final gate fails
specs.when: `hexa status` reads its run record afterwards
specs.then: It shows the failed `gate_result` with its tail, and no gate is run to show it

specs.description: The run record holds the last gate run of the pass
specs.given: Any pass that runs its gate one or more times, with any mix of passing and failing runs
specs.when: The pass ends and `~/.hexa/runs/<id>.json` is read
specs.then: `gate_result` has `passed`, `secs` and `tail` equal to the last gate run of that pass, never an earlier run's

specs.description: Every pass with a baseline starts with exactly one baseline before the hunt
specs.given: Any `hexa harden` pass run without `--no-baseline` on a green tree
specs.then: The first gate run is labelled `baseline`, it precedes every lens call, and exactly one baseline run is made

specs.description: A baseline is judged on at most two runs
specs.given: Any tree whose first baseline run fails
specs.then: The baseline runs a second time; green makes it a flake recorded in `flakes` and the pass goes on; red stops the pass with zero inference calls

specs.description: --no-baseline means no baseline, and the report says so
specs.given: Any tree, red or green, and `--no-baseline`
specs.then: No gate run is labelled `baseline`, and the report states the baseline was skipped

specs.description: Two consecutive failed fixes always ask about the bare tree
specs.given: Any unbatched pass in which two fixes in a row fail the gate
specs.then: The gate runs once on the reverted tree, labelled `without any fix`; red stops the fix loop and lists every remaining confirmed finding as not judged; green continues the loop
